10721|a05588c0.name: Novice Warrior
10721|a05588c0.text:
<Novice Warrior gulps.>

I can do this.

267226|9fad5d95.name: Grey Riding Kodo
267226|9fad5d95.text: <The kodo lets out a happy grunt as you approach.>

267330|d8b814ea.name: Nawka Wildsong
267330|d8b814ea.text: Agol ne wirsh ver ne vandar novaedi veld algos nevren? Va se ras uden vrum bor garde?

2993|f7a5deb4.name: Baine Bloodhoof
2993|f7a5deb4.text: The land has been good to our people, $c. We must be thankful for our good fortune.

3194|57542108.name: Vel'rin Fang
3194|57542108.text: I make sure Sen'jin is supplied with materials from the local beasts. It is an honorable role.

1485-complete.name: Ruzan
1485-complete.text:
Throughout your training as a $c, you will learn to call forth beings of many sorts. Some may not seem it, but all are useful tools.

Do not be fooled by the imp's small size. As you no doubt noticed, it is still a formidable adversary.
1485-complete.title: Vile Familiars

1485-progress.name: Ruzan
1485-progress.text: It is important that you can control the beings that you summon through your magic. There are few enough interested in learning the ways of the $c that I would risk throwing your life away by teaching you something before you are ready.
1485-progress.title: Vile Familiars

1499-accept.name: Ruzan
1499-accept.text:
Zureetha has been sending novices like yourself to help cull the numbers of the creatures in the cave near where you fought the vile familiars.

I think it would be good for you to gain experience by assisting her. Be sure to tell her that you assisted with the imp problem, she'll probably have a reward for you.
1499-accept.title: Vile Familiars

1499-complete.name: Zureetha Fargaze
1499-complete.text:
You have done well, $N.

Although the vile familiars were merely pets of the darker powers within the Burning Blade, your success against them foretells greater deeds ahead.
1499-complete.title: Vile Familiars

1656-progress.name: Innkeeper Kauth
1656-progress.text:
Yes, young one? What can Kauth do for you?

The journey here from the Mesa can be a tremendous burden for some, but a welcome sight for others. Which is it for you, I wonder?
1656-progress.title: A Task Unfinished

2161-accept.name: Ukor
2161-accept.text:
Excuse me?  Can you help me?

I have a load of food here.  I walked along the road and braved scorpids and spiders and worse!  I brought the food to the Valley of Trials because I thought they needed it and I like to help out.  But they don't need any food!  Now I have to take it back to Razor Hill and I'm afraid of all the beasts along the way...

Can you take it for me?  I'm just a peon, but you're a hero.  You fear nothing!

Take it to Innkeeper Grosk at the Razor Hill inn.  Thank you!
2161-accept.title: A Peon's Burden

2161-complete.name: Innkeeper Grosk
2161-complete.text:
Ah, this is the food Ukor brought to the Valley of Trials.  Did they not need it?  Well, I guess they like to starve you heroes in training.  Builds spirit, they say!

Thank you for returning the food.  I'll stick it back on the shelves... but here, let me offer you some refreshment first!

And don't forget to rest here in the inn.  You may be a brave $c ready to take on the world, but if your energy is sapped you won't be doing yourself, or the Horde, much good.
2161-complete.title: A Peon's Burden

3095-progress.name: Dannal Stern
3095-progress.text:
Ah, so you've arrived. Good. I overheard that a few others were able to escape "death" and were heading into town. Perhaps that resilience will pay off in the future also.

You may thank Sylvanas for your freedom... freedom of mind and body. Though you still remain tortured by the plague and its effects, you are now free to come and go as you see fit.
3095-progress.title: Simple Scroll

3376-progress.name: Brave Windfeather
3376-progress.text:
Sharptusk will trouble us no more once you have brought me proof of his death.  It is his head that I seek, $N.

We $r live for the hunt, and there is no greater hunt than against one that is cunning enough to perhaps hunt us back.  If you are successful in this task, young one, you will start to learn what I mean.
3376-progress.title: Break Sharptusk!

4402-accept.name: Galgar
4402-accept.text:
It sure gets hot out here in the Valley of Trials.

<Galgar wipes his brow.>

If only I had some cactus apples, I could make my famous cactus apple surprise! Nothing cools you off faster than a piece of that delicious treat.

I'll tell you what, $N. If you bring me 10 cactus apples, I'll make you a few portions of cactus apple surprise to take with you on your adventures, and a free training manual, too. If you're interested, you can find cactus apples growing near the cactus plants around here.
4402-accept.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise

4402-complete.name: Galgar
4402-complete.text: Wonderful, $N! As promised, here is your cactus apple surprise. Pick one of these training manuals, too. I've got plenty to go around.
4402-complete.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise

4402-progress.name: Galgar
4402-progress.text: Have you finished collecting cactus apples?
4402-progress.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise

5441-accept.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
5441-accept.text:
Cursed peons!  They work hard gathering lumber from the trees of the valley, but they're always taking naps!  I need someone to help keep the peons in line.

You look like the right $r for my task.  Here, you take this blackjack and use it on any lazy peons you find sleeping on the job.  A good smack will get them right back to work!  Return the blackjack when you're done.

Lousy slacking peons...
5441-accept.title: Lazy Peons

5441-complete.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
5441-complete.text: Good, good.  Maybe they'll think twice before slacking next time!  Thanks for the help!
5441-complete.title: Lazy Peons

5441-progress.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
5441-progress.text:
No good lazy...

 Eh?  Do you have my blackjack?  Did you catch any peons sleeping on the job?!
5441-progress.title: Lazy Peons

6394-accept.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
6394-accept.text:
$N, you are a dependable $r.  Can I count on you for another task?

Some time ago I was surveying the cave to the north for minerals, and I left my favorite pick behind.  When I later returned to retrieve it I found the cave was filled with vicious beasts!  Will you go into the cave, the Burning Blade Coven, and get my pick?

I left it in a chamber with waterfalls.  My pick has a spell on it so you can see it in the dark, so you won't have to worry about finding it... just what's guarding it!
6394-accept.title: Thazz'ril's Pick

6394-complete.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
6394-complete.text: Great, you got it!  Thanks a lot, $N.  This is my favorite pick!  Now if my peons ever finish chopping down these trees, maybe we can find a nice cave to mine!
6394-complete.title: Thazz'ril's Pick

6394-progress.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
6394-progress.text: Have you entered the Burning Blade Coven, $N?  Did you find my pick?
6394-progress.title: Thazz'ril's Pick

748-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
748-progress.text: Do you have the paws and talons, $N?
748-progress.title: Poison Water

757-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
757-progress.text: Have you completed the Rite of Strength, $N? I require proof of your valor against the enemy of our tribe, the Bristlebacks.
757-progress.title: Rite of Strength

763-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
763-progress.text: What brings you to my village, $c?
763-progress.title: Rites of the Earthmother

771-progress.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
771-progress.text: Once you have gathered enough well stones from around the water wells and Ambercorn from beneath the trees, I will prepare the Water of the Seers for you.
771-progress.title: Rite of Vision

780-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-progress.text: The aggression of the Battleboars is increasing. Have you sent them a clear message and brought back some snouts and flanks yet?
780-progress.title: The Battleboars

783-accept.name: Deputy Willem
783-accept.text:
I hope you strapped your belt on tight, young $c, because there is work to do here in Northshire.

And I don't mean farming.

The Stormwind guards are hard pressed to keep the peace here, with so many of us in distant lands and so many threats pressing close.  And so we're enlisting the aid of anyone willing to defend their home.  And their alliance.

If you're here to answer the call, then speak with my superior, Marshal McBride.  He's inside the abbey behind me.
783-accept.title: A Threat Within

784-accept.name: Gar'Thok
784-accept.text:
Led by Admiral Proudmoore, the humans of Kul Tiras encroached on Durotar, violating the Warchief's pact made with Jaina Proudmoore in order to defeat Archimonde years ago.

The human aggression was repelled and Tiragarde Keep fell. But recently, the Admiral's reserves, led by Lieutenant Benedict, have retaken the keep and once again pose a threat to our homeland. These humans show no respect for diplomacy.

Prove your honor and travel south to Tiragarde Keep to eliminate the human invaders.
784-accept.title: Vanquish the Betrayers

784-complete.name: Gar'Thok
784-complete.text: Word of your bravery travels fast, $c. Tales of your victory at Tiragarde Keep will be heralded in Orgrimmar.
784-complete.title: Vanquish the Betrayers

786-accept.name: Lar Prowltusk
786-accept.text:
Lower your voice, $c. The Kolkar centaurs lie just over the ridge to the west in Kolkar Crag.

Last night while they were raiding, I snuck into their village and discovered that the dirty beasts have a three-tiered attack planned on the trolls and orcs of Durotar.

We mustn't let their invasion come to fruition. Perhaps you can muster the might needed to infiltrate Kolkar Crag and destroy their attack plans.

Last I saw, they had divided them up amongst three of their leaders.
786-accept.title: Thwarting Kolkar Aggression

788-complete.name: Gornek
788-complete.text:
Hmmm, not bad, $N. But don't let it get to your head...you'll fight tougher than boars in your career.

Nonetheless, you've proven yourself well, and your next trial will be against a considerably more dangerous opponent, so you'll need some extra protection.
788-complete.title: Cutting Teeth

789-accept.name: Gornek
789-accept.text:
Powerful warrior and awkward novice alike have fallen to the venomous sting of the scorpid. You will find large numbers of scorpids northwest of here. Bring me ten of their tails as proof of your prowess in battle.

The antidote for their sting is actually made from venom extracted from their stingers. We keep large quantities of antidote for scorpid venom on hand to heal young bloods just like you...

But I'm sure you won't be needing any of that, will you?
789-accept.title: Sting of the Scorpid

789-complete.name: Gornek
789-complete.text:
There is an important lesson that you must take away from fighting scorpids. The smallest or largest of opponents can still send you to your doom. In fierce combat, any number of things can prove your downfall.

I have no more to teach you, $N. You have done well, and I will watch your progress with interest.
789-complete.title: Sting of the Scorpid

789-progress.name: Gornek
789-progress.text: The carapace of a scorpid isn't so thick that the strength of a determined warrior will be deterred. Strike strongly and without doubt, and the scorpids should prove easy prey.
789-progress.title: Sting of the Scorpid

790-accept.name: Hana'zua
790-accept.text:
$C! I thought I would die out here with none to know of it. While I was hunting the scorpids of the Valley, I came across a particularly vicious-looking one. Hurling myself at it, I managed to inflict a massive blow to its claw before it closed around my leg.

I wasn't ready for its stinger though, and it sliced down and into my chest, cutting into my flesh and letting my blood. Please, you must kill the scorpid for me! My honor must be upheld! I fought it up on the plateau to the south.
790-accept.title: Sarkoth

790-complete.name: Hana'zua
790-complete.text: My blow was not enough to kill him, but looking at the damage I inflicted gives me some small measure of pride. That small measure will be all I have to sustain myself if I die, and in that light, the short list of my life's accomplishments fills me with anger.
790-complete.title: Sarkoth

790-progress.name: Hana'zua
790-progress.text:
Ahhh... my father always said I would never amount to much, and here, lying beneath a tree as life seeps away, I'm afraid it looks like he was right.

At least I wish to die knowing that my last enemy in life lays dead.
790-progress.title: Sarkoth

794-accept.name: Zureetha Fargaze
794-accept.text:
Through my divinations, I see that an item of power hides deep within the Burning Blade Coven, guarded by beasts and black magic.

It is called the Burning Blade Medallion, and your next task is to find it and remove it from the coven.

But be wary, for the medallion may be possessed by an agent of the Burning Blade, and if so then the agent's power would be greater than the familiars you have already encountered.

Go, $N.  You will find the coven in a cave, to the north and west.
794-accept.title: Burning Blade Medallion

794-complete.name: Zureetha Fargaze
794-complete.text:
You retrieved it!  Well done!

Your efforts within the Burning Blade Coven are key in rooting out this cult in the Valley of Trials.  But I fear they have further aims in our land.

We have not seen the end of them.
794-complete.title: Burning Blade Medallion

794-progress.name: Zureetha Fargaze
794-progress.text: Is your task complete, $N?  Do you have the Burning Blade Medallion?
794-progress.title: Burning Blade Medallion

804-accept.name: Hana'zua
804-accept.text:
Seeing the deed you have done for me steels my heart. I cannot fall so easily! I must endure!

But it remains that I cannot make the trek back to the Den unassisted. Please, $N, return to the Den and tell Gornek of my situation. Perhaps he can help me.
804-accept.title: Sarkoth

804-complete.name: Gornek
804-complete.text:
From your description of the beast, I believe you must be speaking of Sarkoth! It is no wonder that Hana'zua was overtaken by it. Aid will be dispatched to him immediately, trouble yourself no more with Hana'zua's plight.

However, I must say, I am most impressed to hear that you brought Sarkoth to death. It is a feat to be proud of, $N. And that you would fight for a stranger's honor, while other tasks occupied your time, your own honor is heightened.
804-complete.title: Sarkoth

805-accept.name: Zureetha Fargaze
805-accept.text:
Your trials against the Burning Blade are finished... here in the Valley.  But I want you to report your findings.

Go to the $r village of Sen'jin and seek out Master Gadrin.  Sen'jin Village is east out of the valley, then right at the fork.

Tell Gadrin of the Burning Blade, and that they have reached the Valley of Trials.  Discover from him if they have yet reached Sen'jin.

Go, $N, and be swift.  I fear the evil found in the Burning Blade Coven is but the herald of a larger threat...
805-accept.title: Report to Sen'jin Village

805-complete.name: Master Gadrin
805-complete.text:
Hm... your report comes at a bad time.  The Burning Blade is not seen here in Sen'jin, but their evil has taken seed off the coast, on the Echo Isles.

The orcs are friends of the Darkspear Trolls.  Honorable friends.  We want to help the orcs, but... we need help too.
805-complete.title: Report to Sen'jin Village

806-accept.name: Orgnil Soulscar
806-accept.text:
We cannot allow the Burning Blade a foothold in Durotar!  We must destroy them before their evil festers!

I have undergone my own investigations and found that a Burning Blade $c, the goblin Fizzle Darkstorm, has camped within Thunder Ridge to the northwest.  There he and his cultist minions spread chaos.

Find and defeat Fizzle, and bring me his dead claw!
806-accept.title: Dark Storms

808-accept.name: Master Gadrin
808-accept.text:
I hear the voice of my brother, Minshina, calling to me in my dreams.

He was taken by Zalazane, the $c on the Echo Isles to the east. And he is dead.

But death is not freedom for my brother. Minshina's spirit was trapped within his own skull by Zalazane's magics. In my dreams I see it with other skulls, in a circle of power on the largest Echo Isle. As long as it remains there my brother's soul is doomed.

Please, $N. Find the circle and retrieve Minshina's skull. Bring it to me.

Free him!
808-accept.title: Minshina's Skull

815-accept.name: Cook Torka
815-accept.text:
Bah! I almost forgot I need to get breakfast ready.

$N, get yourself movin' and get me some taillasher eggs. I'll need at least three of them if I'm going to have enough for tomorrow's meal.

The Bloodtalon taillashers can be fierce, and protect their eggs to the death more often than not. They sometimes bury their eggs too deep in the earth to uncover safely, but if you head to the Echo Isles to the southeast of Sen'jin Village, you can usually find them all over those islands.
815-accept.title: Break a Few Eggs

817-accept.name: Vel'rin Fang
817-accept.text:
Many of the hides we use come from Durotar tigers, $N. Blankets, armor, tents: there are a great many reasons we hunt the beasts, and many reasons we let them thrive at the same time.

The time has come for us to cull the flock, so to speak. Our numbers grow, and our needs are beginning to overwhelm our stocks. I need more hides if I'm to prepare suitable goods for our people.

Bring me 4 Durotar tiger furs, and I shall reward you. You can find them on the islands south of here.
817-accept.title: Practical Prey

818-accept.name: Master Vornal
818-accept.text:
Although my eyes fail me, I still can see clearly enough. More often I must rely on my alchemical skills to aid me in magics that once came easily. But I refuse to take on an apprentice--no $r or orc worthy enough has ever come forward.

Are you worthy? Yes, of course you are... of course you think you are.

I need a few things. Will you get them for me?

I need intact makrura eyes, and vials of crawler mucus. You can find them on any makrura or crawler in Durotar. We shall speak again soon.
818-accept.title: A Solvent Spirit

823-accept.name: Master Gadrin
823-accept.text:
We at Sen'jin Village are not without our own troubles, and we thank you for your aid.  But the news you bring regarding the Burning Blade could be trouble for everyone.

There is an orc stationed at Razor Hill, Orgnil Soulscar, who polices Durotar from evils such as the Burning Blade!  Go to Orgnil and tell him of our plight, as well as your news from the Valley of Trials.  He will want to know these things.

Razor Hill lies to the north.
823-accept.title: Report to Orgnil

823-complete.name: Orgnil Soulscar
823-complete.text: Yes?  You have something to report?  Well then, let's have it!
823-complete.title: Report to Orgnil

825-accept.name: Gar'Thok
825-accept.text:
One of my most observant scouts brings back word that the wreckage of Proudmoore's fleet still remains off the coast of Durotar, just east of Tiragarde Keep.

It is no secret that the humans, in alliance with those foul little creatures known as gnomes, have an advanced knowledge of mechanics. We must have a complete understanding of all our potential enemies. And our people will benefit from this new knowledge as well.

Swim through the wreckage, $N, and retrieve for me the tools of the Alliance.
825-accept.title: From The Wreckage....

826-accept.name: Master Gadrin
826-accept.text:
The witchdoctor Zalazane dwells on the Echo Isles to the east.  They are the isles we once called home.

From there he sends his trolls to the mainland, to hex our people and drag more of them under his sway.

He must be stopped.

Defeat Zalazane and his minions -- former Darkspear trolls, now lost to us.  Bring me his head and I will know his reign of evil is over.
826-accept.title: Zalazane

837-accept.name: Gar'Thok
837-accept.text:
When we arrived, the Razormane quilboars possessed much of the land, and proved a thorn in our sides. Through our efforts we have driven out the largest part of their numbers, but still they remain well-fortified in some areas.

It has gone on long enough, however. For our own protection, we cannot allow the Razormane any hold in our lands. Their camps can be found to the west of here. Look for the brambles and you will find them. Today we drive them from Durotar, tomorrow, perhaps from all of Kalimdor.
837-accept.title: Encroachment

92460-accept.name: Ailee Farheart
92460-accept.text:
Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We've been awaiting your arrival and anticipating your much needed help here in Thendal Village. I imagine you are brimming with both nerves and excitement for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.

<Ailee smiles kindly.>

Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.
92460-accept.title: Coming of Age

96130-accept.name: Yaw Sharpmane
96130-accept.text:
Among the prairie wolves that hunt the hills nearby is one that is especially aggressive. We have taken to calling her Chakuyak. She has become a threat to travelers coming from abroad.

She stalks the trees west of Stonebull Lake, moving from tree stand to tree stand.

End this threat and bring me her pelt, and I will speak your praises to the chief. Beware, for she is dangerous! You might see other hunters seeking her out there, and perhaps you could work as a team.
96130-accept.title: Chakuyak

96604-accept.name: Brakk
96604-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96604-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96604-complete.name: Brakk
96604-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96604-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96605-accept.name: Kaga Wildhoof
96605-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96605-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96652-accept.name: Unknown
96652-accept.text:
<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
96652-accept.title: The Adventurer

96652-complete.name: Brakk
96652-complete.text:
Is that my journal? I've been missing this for a while. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96652-complete.title: The Adventurer

96652-progress.name: Brakk
96652-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96652-progress.title: The Adventurer

96655-accept.name: Brakk
96655-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96655-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96659-accept.name: Chief Hawkwind
96659-accept.text:
Wait, $N. I have another ask of you, before you leave us.

There is an adventurer by the name of Kaga Wildhoof who has made camp just outside of Bloodhoof Village. She has greatly helped me in the past, and now I see my chance to repay her. Could you deliver these supplies to her?
96659-accept.title: The Adventurer

96659-complete.name: Kaga Wildhoof
96659-complete.text:
Chief Hawkwind sent you? I told him back then I needed no compensation, but it seems he hasn't listened. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96659-complete.title: The Adventurer

96659-progress.name: Kaga Wildhoof
96659-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96659-progress.title: The Adventurer

96821-accept.name: Vel'rin Fang
96821-accept.text:
We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.

If your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.
96821-accept.title: Legging It

96821-complete.name: Gar'Thok
96821-complete.text: The peons have been scared to travel south for some time, $N. Now that you've cleared the path a bit, we can get them back to work.
96821-complete.title: Legging It

96822-accept.name: Turroc
96822-accept.text:
We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.

Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.
96822-accept.title: For Honor

96822-complete.name: Turroc
96822-complete.text: These warriors will always be remembered, $N. You have made sure of that.
96822-complete.title: For Honor

96822-progress.name: Turroc
96822-progress.text: Have you done what I asked?
96822-progress.title: For Honor

96825-accept.name: Cook Torka
96825-accept.text:
Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!
96825-accept.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back

96825-complete.name: Cook Torka
96825-complete.text: I'll use these to prepare something tasty, and save the seeds for planting. Someday we'll have prickly pears growing all around Orgrimmar!
96825-complete.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back

97223-accept.name: Xar'Ti
97223-accept.text:
All of the raptors you see before you are ones I have trained myself. They come from all over Kalimdor, but some of the finest come from the Bloodtalon raptors on the isles off our coast.

One raptor amongst them, the Bloodtalon Matriarch, is particularly savage and has killed many from our village and has become too dangerous to leave at our borders. If you can strike her down, return with her eggs so that we can raise the hatchlings as allies instead of enemies.
97223-accept.title: Bloodtalon Matriarch

97225-accept.name: Master Vornal
97225-accept.text:
When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.

The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.

This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.

Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.
97225-accept.title: Forgotten Loa Idols

98575-accept.name: Gornek
98575-accept.text:
Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, $N.

I usually avoid dealing with warlocks if I can help it, but I think you should read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from your newly-appointed trainer, Nartok. He would have words with you when you're ready.
98575-accept.title: Tainted Tablet

98575-complete.name: Nartok
98575-complete.text:
You have just glimpsed the power that can be yours. The feeble and foolish among us are afraid of the path that we tread, but with boldness and cunning we can decide our own fates.

Guard your powers closely. The fearful lash out against that which they do not understand.

Now you are one of us. If you need training in spells then return to me.
98575-complete.title: Tainted Tablet

98575-progress.name: Nartok
98575-progress.text: Ah, you received my message. Excellent. We orcs have a long and turbulent history with the entities of the Nether, but now we forge our own path, in command of our destiny. You, too, can seize the power to shape the future for your people. Where our leaders falter, we are ready to press forward and claim our rightful place. You will be of eminence among the trolls.
98575-progress.title: Tainted Tablet

99079-accept.name: Brave Wildrunner
99079-accept.text:
The Longwalkers are our people's most trusted scouts. Though their loyalty lies with the High Chieftain alone, young Baine at times seeks their aid.

This is one such time. Longwalker Malah was dispatched near our borders to the east and did not return last night after three days. When this occurs, it is our duty to confirm their safety.

I must ensure the village remains safe. Prove yourself, and seek Malah out. You will know her by her headband and feathered staff, emblematic of the Longwalkers.
99079-accept.title: Longwalker Malah

99108-accept.name: Krang Stonehoof
99108-accept.text:
Hail, young $c. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.
99108-accept.title: Sparring Match

99108-complete.name: Krang Stonehoof
99108-complete.text:
You honor me with your abilities, $c. Perhaps the new generation has hope yet.

Take these to tend to your wounds, for many more battles await you in this harsh world.
99108-complete.title: Sparring Match

99411-accept.name: Ahab Wheathoof
99411-accept.text:
Help, $N! My prized puppy, Kyle, has run away! I just know he's running around Bloodhoof Village, lost and hungry.

Will you find him and feed him? Once he eats he will settle down and come home.

To feed him you will need to find food. His favorite meal is tender strider meat. Just venture east and you should find plenty of striders. Hunt one down and take its succulent meat to Kyle. When you see Kyle in town, put the meat down and he is sure to come to you.
99411-accept.title: Kyle's Gone Missing!

99411-complete.name: Ahab Wheathoof
99411-complete.text: Fantastic work, $N! Kyle came home as soon as he ate and went straight to bed. Thank you for your help.
99411-complete.title: Kyle's Gone Missing!
